chunks: Mansur ibn Yunus narrated from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I was sitting with a judge, and Abu Ja'far عليه السلام was seated with him, when two men came to him.

One of them said: I hired this man's camels to carry goods for me to some mines, and I stipulated that he should bring me into the mine on such-and-such a day, because there is a market there that I fear I may miss. So if I am delayed from that, I would deduct from the hire for every day he detained me such-and-such, and indeed he delayed me from that time for such-and-such a number of days.
The judge said: This is an invalid condition; pay him his full hire.
So when the man stood up, Abu Ja'far عليه السلام turned to me and said: His condition is valid so long as he does not reduce the whole of his hire.

key_terms.الْكِرَاءِ: the hire payment or rental fee
key_terms.الْمَعَادِنِ: mines or mining locations serving as the destination
key_terms.تَكَارَيْتُ: I hired for transport or rental use
key_terms.سُوقًا: a market whose timing affected the agreement

ai.seo_question: Is it valid in Islamic law to stipulate a deduction in payment if a hired transporter delivers late?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses a hire agreement in which a transporter was required to deliver goods by a specified time, with a deduction in payment for delay. Abu Ja'far عليه السلام affirmed the validity of such a condition, provided the deduction does not cancel the entire hire. The report is significant in jurisprudence for contractual stipulations, delayed delivery, and limits on financial deductions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3273 - Mansur ibn Yunus narrated from Muhammad al-Halabi:

I was sitting with a judge, and Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) was also present.
Two men approached the judge.

One of them said: "I hired this man's camels to transport my goods to a certain mine. I stipulated that he must get me there on a specific day because there is a market there, and I feared missing it.
I also stipulated that if I was delayed, I would deduct a specific amount from the fare for each day of the delay.
However, he delayed me for several days beyond the agreed time."
The judge said: "This condition is invalid. Pay him his full fare."
When the man left, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) turned to me and said: "His condition is valid as long as he does not deduct the entire fare."
